set.body:
Purpose:
Replace silent parse loss with a domain-level diagnostic/report contract while preserving a usable project when policy allows.

Scope:
- Add stable BidsIssueCode, severity, path, optional entity/field context, and message types.
- Define a BidsValidationReport or equivalent domain result that separates usable values plus diagnostics from fatal rejection.
- Add a checked manifest construction path that retains every BidsRegistry.parsePath failure instead of converting it silently to None.
- Define explicit strict and permissive scan policies and deterministic issue ordering independent of collection/hash iteration.
- Preserve the existing permissive constructor as a compatibility facade or document a staged deprecation.
- Provide a narrow mapping seam for fmri-workflow CatalogIssue without coupling bids upward to fmri-workflow.

Acceptance:
- A fixture with multiple malformed names reports all expected issues in stable path/code order.
- Valid and unknown non-BIDS files remain distinguishable from invalid BIDS-intended files.
- A valid manifest is byte-for-byte/structurally equivalent to the current path for the same inputs.
- Shared tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: BIDS F1: structured diagnostics and checked manifest scans
